resources.string: A QWERTY keyboard made of glass.
Turn it on in the system list of input methods.
Pick Glass Keyboard as the keyboard to type with.
What the keyboard picks up as you use it. Everything learnt stays on this phone.
Remember the words you type and which ones follow each other, so the three suggestions get better.
Remember which emoji you pick after which words, so the two emoji suggestions get better.
Fix a word as you finish it. Press backspace straight after to put back what you typed — the keyboard takes that as a no and remembers it.
Clears learnt words, emoji and corrections. The switches above and the built-in word list are left alone.
Learnt words, word pairs, emoji habits and corrections will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
